patches.evidence: Automoli, 'Skoda Superb II Combi (facelift 2013)': Radstand 2761 mm (Länge 4833 mm, Breite 1817 mm). Auto-data.net and autoevolution also list 2761 mm for the 2013 facelift. This is consistent with Škoda's 2015 press release for the successor: 'wheelbase has been extended by 80 mm to 2,841 mm'. Note: ADAC lists 2758 mm (Herstellerangabe), but only for the pre-facelift 01/10-05/13 Combi.
